description: Search the manifoldbt documentation: DSL rules and pitfalls, indicator and API signatures, config fields, execution semantics (which price a stop or target fills at, which fee each fill pays, what a reversal counts as, which ddof an indicator uses), how to read result metrics honestly, and worked examples. Ask in natural language ('how do I reference another symbol', 'what happens when a bar gaps through my stop', 'is this Sharpe meaningful') or by name ('symbol_ref', 'warmup_bars'). Pass a result's exact title to read that chunk again. A chunk already sent in this session is not sent again.
name: search_docs
